S1.text:
Raseen Facilities Management LLC is pleased to submit its technical proposal for Facilities Management Services at Al Ghaf Community Centre and four satellite community facilities under tender MNDA/PRC/2026/057.

As the Authority's facilities management partner for its community centres since January 2024, Raseen FM knows these buildings, their users and their seasonal demands better than any other provider. Our team has achieved 100% PPM compliance across all MNDA community centres since mobilisation. Our helpdesk resolves 98% of requests at first contact.

Raseen FM employs 1,096 people and manages 46 sites covering 1,874,000 m² across the UAE. We hold ISO 41001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 certifications. We have recorded zero lost-time injuries in the last five years.

Our in-house CAFM platform, RFM Connect, is hosted in the UAE and gives the Authority real-time visibility of every work order through a read-only client portal. The RFM Care Centre operates 24 hours a day in Arabic and English through a single toll-free number.

With an In-Country Value score of 31.4% and a structured Emiratisation programme, Raseen FM is committed to building national capability in the facilities management sector.

We propose a dedicated team led by Sanjay Nair, a Certified Facility Manager with 19 years of experience, who currently manages the Authority's community centres contract.
